# Trial PCA
```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/eviec/Git/malagasy_diversity")
data <- pcadapt::read.pcadapt(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/merge_full_no_relatives.bed"), type = "bed") 

pca1 <- pcadapt::pcadapt(input = data, K=5)
plot(pca1, option = "screeplot")

fam <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/merge_full_no_relatives.fam"))

groups <- tidyr::separate(fam, V2, into = c("char_prefix", "numeric_suffix"), sep = "(?<=\\D)(?=\\d)")
fam <- cbind(fam,groups$char_prefix)
colnames(fam)[7] <- "group"

  
plot(pca1, option = "scores", pop = fam$group)


unique(fam$group)
#"BET" "CH"  "IR"  "ANT" "NW"  "SH"  "BJM" "SA" 

fam$Population <- ifelse(fam$group == "BET","Betsimisaraka",
                         ifelse(fam$group == "CH","Merina",
                         ifelse(fam$group == "IR", "Diego",
                         ifelse(fam$group == "ANT","Diego",
                         ifelse(fam$group == "NW", "Sakalava/Tsimhety",
                         ifelse(fam$group == "SH", "Betsileo",
                         ifelse(fam$group == "BJM", "Borneo",
                         ifelse(fam$group == "SA","Khomani San, South Africa",NA)))))))) 


pca1$singular.values
variance.explained=(pca1$singular.values)^2 
variance.explained
sum(variance.explained)

PCA_scores <- as.data.frame(pca1$scores)

ggplot2::ggplot(PCA_scores, ggplot2::aes(x = V1, y= V2, color = fam$Population)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Madagascar Principle Component Analysis", x = "PC1 7.1%", y = "PC2 2.2%", color = "Population")

#ggplot2::ggplot(PCA_scores, ggplot2::aes(x = V3, y= V4, color = fam$Population)) +
#  ggplot2::geom_point() +
#  ggplot2::labs(title = "Madagascar Principle Component Analysis", x = #"PC3", y = "PC4", color = "Population")

```
